SMASHING DRIVE is an arcade game based on the frantic driving of a “super-cab” in New York City. The taxi driver picks up a client and races trough NY trying to avoid traffic jams and obstacles, discovering many surprising shortcuts and getting extra advantages distributed at points along the course, that convert the cab in a fantastic car worthy of Batman or James Bond. Almost everything is permitted but the car looses speed when smashes against an obstacle, so bad drivers would be punished with rather poor scores. The goal of the player is to complete the selected circuit in the least possible time, dodging the obstacles that cut across his path, at the same time keeping a fierce competition with another cab controlled by the CPU. Two players can also compete one against each other when the machines are linked.
